description: UIM Application Event Hub — formations, systems, event catalog, channels, subscriptions, delivery and dead letters

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Read
scopes.description: Read the landscape, event catalog, subscriptions, messages and dead letters

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Publish
scopes.description: Publish CloudEvents (technical users of producer systems)

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Operate
scopes.description: Deliver, pull and acknowledge messages; requeue and discard dead letters; pause and resume subscriptions

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Manage
scopes.description: Maintain formations, systems, event types, channels, subscriptions and filters

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Admin
scopes.description: Manage the user accounts of the built-in login (not used with XSUAA)

role-templates.name: Producer
role-templates.description: Publish events of a producer system

role-templates.name: IntegrationAdministrator
role-templates.description: Maintain the landscape, catalog and subscriptions; operate
